title: Type-Safe Builder Steps
goal: Enforce required configuration steps using type states before calling build.
hints: The host method transitions the builder from NoHost to Host.
The build method should only be available when the state is Host.
explanation: The `host()` method returns `Builder<Host>` after populating the field. Implementing `build()` specifically for `Builder<Host>` guarantees at compile time that `build()` cannot be called before `host()` has provided the required string. `NoHost` has no field `.0`, so attempting to implement `build()` on `Builder<NoHost>` causes a compiler error.
